column1: # Fork-only interface strings (ours, never offered upstream): rows for the UI strings the fork
# added that storytold/craft-i18n has no row for. `build.rs` appends each locale's rows to the
# craft-i18n `photocraft.tsv` it embeds, so lookups read them as PhotoCraft's own rows. A row that
# craft-i18n already has is left out (craft-i18n's wins) with a build warning: delete it here once
# the pinned `craft-i18n.rev` carries it. Without `CRAFT_I18N_DIR` nothing is embedded and the
# Columns, separated by a TAB:  locale <TAB> context <TAB> source <TAB> translation. The last three
# are a craft-i18n catalog row (its `docs/catalog-format.md`: escapes, `{name}` placeholders).
# Recovered from the fork's own catalogs before the move to craft-i18n
